Lamp error guards: compiled public rows

The mutation name omits receivers and locations. This argument therefore
covers every matching guard in fire.made, stick.made, spot.made and
maser.made, including guards already killed by private-constructor tests.
No exported API accepts a caller-authored private row. Make checks sown
seeds, every sprout is sown, and each draw lies in [0,1).

The campfire has 7..10 cobbles at radius .35.. .5 m and 4..6 sticks at
.55 of that radius. Ring jitter .3/.2, twist 1 and lean 55 degrees satisfy
the arrangement domain. Cobbles have lengths .064.. .256 m, axis ratios
.6.. .95 and .5.. .9, wear .3.. .9, and 12 cuts. Sticks have lengths
.5.. .75 m, foot radii .025.. .04 m, taper .6, and 6 cuts. The light is
1100..1500 K, 2000..6000 W, isotropic, with flicker .35. Ring placements
have scale .7..1.3 or .8..1.2 and finite rotations. Both materials exist;
gather and placement remain within their constructor domains.

The bonfire also calls stick.made: its logs are 6..8 m long, with foot
radii .30.. .45 m, taper .85 and 8 cuts. Its 11..15 logs at radius
2.4..3 m, lean 21 degrees and jitter .2 satisfy the same arrangement
bounds and have a dressed body. It creates no lamp.

The spotlight stand is 1..1.6 m tall, radius .02 m. Its head length,
back and front are .3, .07 and .12 m, with 12 cuts and tilt -10..-25
degrees. The axis is finite and nonzero; spaceAlong and placed retain
a right-handed orthonormal orientation. The lamp is 3200 K, 500..2000 W,
with half-angle 12..25 degrees and soft edge 6 degrees, always below pi.

The maser mount is 1.5..2.5 m tall, radius .06 m. Its dish is 2..4 m;
head length is .25 of that, back .1 and front .5, with 16 cuts and tilt
30..70 degrees. Wavelength 299792458/1420.4e6 m, aperture and .5..5 W
power are finite and positive. The aperture receives a line spectrum,
and its finite half-angle is capped at pi.

All these shape, seed, cut, material, placement and light domains satisfy
the callees. A deleted error guard therefore leaves the same public value.
Invalid private rows are useful constructor tests, but outside this fixed
row argument. Observable Lights/Things placement refusals are separate.
Review again when a row, public construction door or callee changes.
